bagPolicy.summary: Mohegan Sun Arena does not allow backpacks, string bags, diaper bags, shopping bags, messenger bags, briefcases or rolling bags. No size limit is published.
bagPolicy.note: Policy as published by the Connecticut Sun, the arena's home team. The arena does not publish a bag size limit; check the event page for show-specific rules.

parking.summary: Mohegan Sun has more than 13,000 on-site guest parking spaces. You can reserve a spot in Riverview Reserved Parking, a gated lot on the ground floor of the Riverview garage, through ParkWhiz, and it must be bought in advance. Valet at the hotel runs 24 hours a day.

rideshare.note: Concerto hasn't confirmed Mohegan Sun Arena's rideshare pickup and drop-off details from an official source yet. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

concessions.summary: Concerto hasn't confirmed Mohegan Sun Arena's food and drink details from an official source yet. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Mohegan Sun Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry isn't allowed once the event is over. If you need to leave before it ends and plan to return, have an usher scan your ticket out at the entry doors, or you will be denied re-entry.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Mohegan Sun Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The arena has two entrances: Earth, by the Box Office, and Sky, near the Arena Club.
